_help: Hand-written descriptions for individual games. Each entry: [what the game is, how to play]. The second part is optional. Games without an entry get a description built from their category.
slope: Slope is an endless 3D running game where you steer a ball down a neon track that gets faster the longer you survive. Gaps, ramps and red blocks appear without warning, so every run is a test of reflexes.
Use the left and right arrow keys (or A and D) to roll the ball. Stay on the green track, avoid the red obstacles and see how far you can get before you fall off the edge.
slope3: Slope 3 continues the fast-rolling formula of Slope with new track layouts and tighter turns. The ball keeps speeding up, so a single late move ends the run.
Steer with the arrow keys or A and D, line yourself up early for jumps and keep away from the red blocks.
slope2-player: Slope 2 Player puts two balls on the same speeding track so you can race a friend on one keyboard. Whoever stays on the course longest wins the round.
One player steers with A and D, the other with the left and right arrow keys.
run-3: Run 3 sends a small grey alien running through tunnels floating in space. Walls become floors as you rotate the tunnel, and the game mixes an endless mode with a long story of hand-built levels and unlockable characters.
Use the arrow keys to move and jump. Run onto a wall to rotate the whole tunnel, and use the gaps' edges to keep your momentum.
run2: Run 2 is the second game in the Run series: guide the alien through space tunnels full of holes, rotating the tunnel to find solid ground.
Move and jump with the arrow keys, and step onto the walls to turn the tunnel.
run: Run is the original space-tunnel runner that started the Run series. Run along the walls of a floating tunnel and jump over the gaps.
Use the arrow keys to move left and right and the up arrow or space bar to jump.
2048: 2048 is the classic number puzzle: slide numbered tiles on a 4×4 grid, and when two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one. Keep combining until you build a 2048 tile, or go further for a high score.
Use the arrow keys (or swipe on a touch screen) to move every tile at once. Plan ahead so the board doesn't fill up.
cookie-clicker: Cookie Clicker is the idle game that made clicking famous. Click the giant cookie to bake, then spend your cookies on cursors, grandmas, farms and factories that bake even more for you.
Click the big cookie to start, then buy buildings and upgrades from the store on the right. Your bakery keeps producing while you watch.
moto-x3m: Moto X3M is a stunt bike racing game with short, obstacle-packed levels full of loops, ramps, saws and explosives. Finish fast for three stars, and flip in the air to cut time off the clock.
Accelerate with the up arrow, brake or reverse with the down arrow, and lean back and forward with the left and right arrows to land safely and do flips.
motox3m2: Moto X3M 2 adds new tracks and tougher stunts to the stunt bike series, with more traps and timed jumps to master.
Use the arrow keys to ride, brake and lean. Flips save time, but land on your wheels.
motox3m3: Moto X3M 3 brings another set of stunt bike levels with new obstacles and bike unlocks.
Ride with the up and down arrows and use left and right to balance and flip.
moto-x3m-pool-party: Moto X3M Pool Party takes the stunt bike series to a summer setting full of pools, slides and inflatables.
Use the arrow keys to accelerate, brake and lean through each course.
moto-x3m-winter: Moto X3M Winter is the snowy edition of the stunt bike series, with icy ramps and Christmas-themed traps.
Ride with the arrow keys and lean to keep your bike upright on the frozen tracks.
moto-x3m-spooky-land: Moto X3M Spooky Land is the Halloween edition of the stunt bike series, with haunted tracks, pumpkins and graveyards to race through.
Use the arrow keys to ride and lean, and time your jumps around the spooky traps.
fireboy-and-water-girl: Fireboy and Watergirl in the Forest Temple is a co-op puzzle platformer. Guide both characters to their exits: Fireboy can cross lava but not water, Watergirl can cross water but not lava, and both are stopped by green goo.
Fireboy moves with the arrow keys and Watergirl with W, A and D. Play with a friend on one keyboard, or control both yourself, and collect the gems on the way.
fireboy-and-water-girl2: Fireboy and Watergirl 2: The Light Temple adds light beams and mirrors to the co-op puzzle series. Redirect the light to open doors while keeping each character away from the wrong element.
Arrow keys for Fireboy, W, A and D for Watergirl.
fireboy-and-water-girl3: Fireboy and Watergirl 3: The Ice Temple introduces slippery ice and freezing water, so both heroes have new hazards to work around together.
Fireboy uses the arrow keys and Watergirl uses W, A and D.
fireboy-and-water-girl5: Fireboy and Watergirl 5: Elements combines the hazards from the earlier temples into one adventure across several themed areas.
Play together on one keyboard: arrow keys for Fireboy, W, A and D for Watergirl.
fireboy-and-water-girl6: Fireboy and Watergirl 6: Fairy Tales brings the co-op duo into a fairy-tale world with new puzzles built around teamwork.
Arrow keys move Fireboy and W, A and D move Watergirl.
papa-pizza-good: Papa's Pizzeria is the time-management cooking game where you run Papa Louie's pizza shop. Take orders, add toppings in the right places, bake for the right time and slice it the way each customer wants.
Use the mouse to work each station: order, topping, baking and cutting. Better pizzas earn bigger tips for shop upgrades.
papas-burger-iiiaaaaa: Papa's Burgeria puts you in charge of Papa Louie's burger restaurant. Grill patties to the right doneness, build each burger in the order the customer asked for, and keep the line moving.
Use the mouse to take orders, flip burgers on the grill and stack toppings at the build station.
papas-freezer-i-a: Papa's Freezeria is a cooking game set in an island sundae shop. Pick the cup, blend the flavors and add whipped cream, sauces and toppings exactly as ordered.
Work the order, build, mix and topping stations with your mouse. Accurate sundaes earn better tips.
papas-taco-mia: Papa's Taco Mia! has you running a taco restaurant: cook meats, assemble the shells and add toppings and sauces in the order each customer requests.
Use the mouse to move between the grill and build stations and serve orders as they come in.
papas-cupcake-ria: Papa's Cupcakeria is a bakery cooking game. Bake cupcakes, frost them and decorate them with toppings for seasonal orders.
Use the mouse to bake, frost and decorate, keeping an eye on every order ticket.
papas-pancake-ria: Papa's Pancakeria is a breakfast cooking game where you flip pancakes, French toast and waffles and pour drinks for a busy morning crowd.
Use the mouse to cook, stack and top each order the way it's written.
papas-sushi-ria: Papa's Sushiria lets you run a sushi restaurant: cook the rice, roll the fillings, cut the rolls and serve them with bubble tea.
Work each station with the mouse and follow the order tickets closely.
papas-cheese-ria: Papa's Cheeseria is about grilled cheese sandwiches: choose breads and cheeses, toast them, cook fries and add toppings to order.
Use the mouse to build, grill and serve each sandwich with its fries.
papas-hot-dog-geri-a: Papa's Hot Doggeria puts you in a ballpark hot dog stand serving hot dogs, popcorn and drinks to fans.
Use the mouse to grill sausages, build hot dogs and fill drink and popcorn orders.
papas-past-aria: Papa's Pastaria is an Italian restaurant cooking game: cook pasta, simmer sauces and bake bread for each table.
Use the mouse to cook, plate and top every order.
papa-baker-i-a: Papa's Bakeria has you baking pies: make the crust, add fillings, bake and decorate each pie to order.
Use the mouse to work the build, bake and topping stations.
pa-pass-cooper-i-a: Papa's Scooperia is an ice cream shop cooking game where you bake cookies and scoop ice cream into sundaes.
Use the mouse to bake, scoop and top each order.
papa-swinger-i-a: Papa's Wingeria is a chicken wing restaurant game: fry wings, toss them in sauces and plate them with sides and dips.
Use the mouse to fry, sauce and arrange each order.
papa-louie-when-pizzas-attack: Papa Louie: When Pizzas Attack! is a platform adventure where Papa Louie fights pizza monsters to rescue his customers.
Use the arrow keys to run and jump, and the space bar to attack.
b-loons-td1: Bloons Tower Defense is the first game in Ninja Kiwi's tower defense series. Place dart monkeys along the track to pop every balloon before it reaches the end.
Click a tower in the side panel and place it beside the path. Earn money from popped balloons to buy more towers and upgrades.
b-loons-td2: Bloons Tower Defense 2 adds new tower types and upgrades to the balloon-popping tower defense series.
Place towers with the mouse, upgrade them between rounds and stop every bloon from getting through.
b-loons-td3: Bloons Tower Defense 3 brings more tracks, stronger bloons and new monkey towers to the series.
Use the mouse to build and upgrade towers along the path.
b-loons-td4: Bloons Tower Defense 4 is one of the most popular entries in the series, with branching upgrades and tough later rounds.
Place towers with the mouse, plan your upgrades and start each round when you're ready.
b-loons-td5: Bloons Tower Defense 5 offers two upgrade paths per tower, special agents and many tracks to master.
Build and upgrade monkeys with the mouse and pop every bloon on the track.
b-loons: Bloons is the original Ninja Kiwi puzzle game: throw darts to pop as many balloons as possible with a limited number of shots.
Aim with the mouse, then click and hold to set the power of each throw.
vex: Vex is a stickman platformer about precise jumps, wall slides and spinning saw blades. Each act is a gauntlet of traps with checkpoints along the way.
Move with the arrow keys or A and D, jump with up or W, and slide or duck with down or S.
vex2: Vex 2 continues the stickman platformer with new acts, harder traps and more ways to move.
Use the arrow keys or WASD to run, jump, wall-jump and slide.
vex3: Vex 3 adds new acts and a challenge mode to the precision stickman platformer series.
Run and jump with the arrow keys or WASD, and slide under hazards with down.
vex4: Vex 4 brings more acts of saws, spikes and moving platforms for the stickman runner.
Use the arrow keys or WASD to move, jump and slide.
vex5: Vex 5 continues the series with new movement tricks and tougher obstacle courses.
Move and jump with the arrow keys or WASD.
vex6: Vex 6 is a later entry in the stickman platformer series with new acts to beat.
Use the arrow keys or WASD to run, jump and slide through each act.
vex7: Vex 7 adds another round of acts and challenges to the stickman platformer series.
Run, jump and slide with the arrow keys or WASD.
vex8: Vex 8 brings new levels and traps to the long-running stickman platformer series.
Use the arrow keys or WASD to get through each act.
duck-life: Duck Life is a training game: raise a duck, train it in running, swimming and flying mini-games, and enter it in races to win coins and the championship.
Choose a training mini-game to level up a skill, buy seeds to boost your duck, then race when it's ready.
ducklife2: Duck Life 2: World Champion continues the duck-training series with new skills, more races and a world championship to win.
Train your duck's skills in mini-games and enter races to earn coins.
ducklife3: Duck Life 3: Evolution lets you breed and train ducks with different abilities and races for each.
Train in the mini-games, keep your duck fed and race to climb the ranks.
ducklife4: Duck Life 4 adds climbing and jumping skills, a bigger world and more races to the duck-training series.
Level up skills in training mini-games and enter races in each region.
ducklfe5: Duck Life 5: Treasure Hunt has you training your duck while searching for treasure across a new world.
Train skills, race and explore to find treasure and cosmetics.
happy-wheels: Happy Wheels is a ragdoll physics game where you ride wheelchairs, bikes and carts through deadly obstacle courses. It's known for its over-the-top crashes and huge library of user-made levels.
Use the arrow keys to move and lean, the space bar for your character's main action, and shift and ctrl for extra actions. Press Z to eject.
learn-to-fly: Learn to Fly is an upgrade game about a penguin determined to fly. Launch off a ramp, earn money from each attempt and buy better gliders, rockets and sleds to fly farther.
Use the arrow keys to tilt while gliding and the space bar to fire your rocket. Spend your earnings in the shop between flights.
learn-to-fly2: Learn to Fly 2 sends the penguin back up the ramp with new upgrades, a story mode and a sandbox.
Tilt with the arrow keys and use your boosters to go farther, then upgrade between launches.
learn-to-fly3: Learn to Fly 3 takes the penguin into space with a modular rocket builder and many more goals.
Build a craft, launch it and steer with the arrow keys.
learn-to-fly-idle: Learn to Fly Idle is the idle version of the series: your penguin keeps launching and earning while you invest in upgrades.
Click to launch and buy upgrades as your income grows.
earn-to-die: Earn to Die is a zombie driving game: build up your car, drive as far as you can through crowds of zombies, and spend your earnings on armor, engines and guns to make it farther next time.
Accelerate and brake with the up and down arrows, tilt with left and right, and use space for your boost.
earntodie2: Earn to Die 2 continues the zombie road trip with new vehicles, longer levels and more upgrades.
Drive with the arrow keys, boost with space and upgrade your vehicle between runs.
bob-the-robber: Bob the Robber is a stealth puzzle game: sneak through buildings, avoid guards and cameras, and grab the loot without getting caught.
Use the arrow keys to move, and interact with doors and switches to get past security.
raft-wars: Raft Wars is a turn-based shooting game where Simon and his brother defend their buried treasure from raiders on rafts.
Aim with the mouse and click to throw. Account for distance and the arc of each shot.
raftwars2: Raft Wars 2 sends the brothers to a water park for more turn-based battles, new weapons and upgrades.
Aim and shoot with the mouse, and pick the right weapon for each enemy.
riddle-school: Riddle School is a point-and-click adventure about Phil, a student trying to escape school by solving silly puzzles and talking his way past teachers.
Click on objects and people to interact, and combine items in your inventory to solve puzzles.
riddle-school-2: Riddle School 2 continues Phil's attempts to escape school with new rooms, characters and puzzles.
Click around each scene to find items and solve riddles.
riddle-school-3: Riddle School 3 is the third chapter of the point-and-click comedy series, with Phil escaping from a new place.
Point and click to explore, collect items and solve the puzzles.
impossible-quiz: The Impossible Quiz is a famously tricky trivia game where many questions are jokes, riddles or traps. You have three lives for over 100 questions, and some answers are hidden in plain sight.
Read each question carefully and click your answer. Think sideways: the obvious choice is often wrong.
impossible-quiz2: The Impossible Quiz 2 is the sequel to the trick-question quiz, with new riddles, timed questions and bombs.
Click the answer you think is right, and watch for questions that need something other than a click.
paper-io: Paper.io is a territory game: move your block out of your area to draw a line, then return home to claim everything inside it. Other players can cut your line while you're outside, so balance greed and safety.
Steer with the mouse or the arrow keys. Loop back to your own color to capture land.
paper-io3d: Paper.io 3D brings the territory-grabbing game into 3D. Leave your zone to draw new borders and return to claim the space.
Steer with the mouse or arrow keys and avoid having your trail cut.
slither-io: Slither.io is a snake game where you eat glowing orbs to grow longer. Make other snakes crash into your body to eat what they leave behind.
Steer with the mouse and click or hold to speed up, which costs some length.
1v1-lol: 1v1.LOL is a third-person building and shooting game. Build walls, ramps and floors in a second to gain the high ground, then out-aim your opponent in quick battles.
Move with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and use the building keys (Z, X, C, V by default) to place structures.
tunnel-rush: Tunnel Rush is a fast 3D obstacle game where you race down a colorful rotating tunnel and dodge walls, bars and spinning blades.
Use the left and right arrow keys or A and D to rotate and avoid the obstacles.
drift-hunters: Drift Hunters is a 3D drifting game with tunable cars and several tracks. Earn points by sliding sideways for as long as you can, then spend them on new cars and upgrades.
Drive with the arrow keys or WASD, use the space bar for the handbrake to start a drift, and shift to change gears.
drift-boss: Drift Boss is a one-button driving game: your car drives along a twisting track on its own, and you drift around each corner without falling off.
Click or press any key to turn, and release to go straight. Time your turns to stay on the road.
madalin-stunt-cars: Madalin Stunt Cars is a 3D stunt driving game with supercars and big open stunt maps full of ramps and loops.
Drive with the arrow keys or WASD, use space for the handbrake and C to change the camera.
basket-random: Basket Random is a silly two-player basketball game where floppy players, changing courts and random physics make every point unpredictable.
Each player uses a single key to jump and shoot: W for player one and the up arrow for player two.
soccer-random: Soccer Random is a chaotic two-player soccer game with floppy players and random fields, balls and conditions every round.
Player one uses W and player two uses the up arrow to jump and kick.
volley-random: Volley Random is a two-player volleyball game with wobbly players and random conditions each round.
Player one uses W and player two uses the up arrow to jump and hit the ball.
boxing-random: Boxing Random is a one-button boxing game with floppy fighters and random rules every round.
Player one uses W and player two uses the up arrow to punch.
stickman-hook: Stickman Hook is a swinging game: launch your stickman from hook to hook, letting go at the right moment to fly across each level.
Click or tap and hold to grab the nearest hook, and release to let go.
big-tower-tiny-square: Big Tower Tiny Square is a precision platformer about a tiny square climbing a giant tower to rescue a pineapple. Checkpoints are generous, but the jumps are tight.
Move with the arrow keys or WASD and jump with up, W or space. Wall-jump by jumping against walls.
ovo: OvO is a fast platformer where you run, slide, wall-jump and dive through levels full of spikes and moving platforms.
Move with the arrow keys, jump with up, and use down to slide or dive in the air.
ovo2: OvO 2 continues the speedy platformer with new levels and movement challenges.
Use the arrow keys to run, jump, slide and dive.
drive-mad: Drive Mad is a physics driving game where you get a car across wobbly bridges, ramps and moving platforms to the finish line without flipping it.
Use the right arrow or D to drive forward and the left arrow or A to brake and reverse. Balance carefully on bumpy ground.
eggy-car: Eggy Car is a hill-climbing game where you drive a car with an egg balanced on top. Go as far as you can without letting the egg fall off.
Hold the right arrow or the gas pedal to drive and the left arrow to brake. Go gently over hills.
monkey-mart: Monkey Mart is a supermarket management game: grow crops, stock the shelves, serve customers and hire monkey helpers to expand your store.
Move with the arrow keys or WASD. Walk over items to pick them up and over shelves to stock them.
idle-breakout: Idle Breakout combines brick breaking with an idle game: buy balls that bounce and break bricks on their own, and upgrade them to clear levels faster.
Click bricks to damage them and buy and upgrade balls with the money you earn.
doge-miner: Doge Miner is an idle clicker where you mine Dogecoin with the Shiba Inu dog, buy helpers and rockets, and travel to the moon and beyond.
Click the rock to mine and buy helpers and upgrades in the shop.
snow-rider: Snow Rider 3D is a sledding game where you ride down a snowy hill, dodging trees, snowmen and other obstacles while collecting gifts.
Use the left and right arrow keys to steer and up to speed up.
tomb-of-the-mask: Tomb of the Mask is an arcade maze game where you dash through a tomb, collecting dots and coins while a rising flood chases you.
Swipe or use the arrow keys to dash in a direction; you keep moving until you hit a wall.
worlds-hardest-game: The World's Hardest Game is a minimalist puzzle game: guide a red square past moving blue dots, collect the yellow coins and reach the green zone.
Move with the arrow keys or WASD. Watch the patterns before you move.
worlds-hardest-game-2: The World's Hardest Game 2 brings new mazes and patterns to the famously difficult red-square puzzle.
Move with the arrow keys or WASD and time your moves between the blue dots.
qwop: QWOP is a running game where you control an athlete's thighs and calves separately. Getting him to run 100 meters without falling is harder than it sounds.
Press Q and W to move the thighs and O and P to move the calves.
line-rider: Line Rider is a drawing sandbox: draw lines and tracks, then press play to watch a sledder ride them.
Use the pencil and line tools to draw a track, then press play to send the rider down it.
google-dino: The Google Dino game is the endless runner from Chrome's offline page: help the T-Rex jump over cacti and duck under birds as it speeds up.
Press space or the up arrow to jump and the down arrow to duck.
interactive-buddy: Interactive Buddy is a sandbox where you play with a little buddy using toys, objects and tools you buy with the money you earn.
Use the mouse to pick items from the menu and interact with your buddy.
kitten-cannon: Kitten Cannon is a launch game: fire a kitten out of a cannon and see how far it bounces off trampolines and obstacles.
Set the angle and power with the mouse, then click to fire.
toss-the-turtle: Toss the Turtle is a launch game where you fire a turtle from a cannon and keep it in the air with guns and bombs.
Set the angle and power and click to launch. Shoot the turtle in the air to keep it going.
burrito-bison: Burrito Bison is a launch game about a luchador wrestler bouncing across a candy land, flattening gummy bears to keep his momentum.
Click to launch, then click to slam down when you have a slam ready. Buy upgrades between runs.
sushi-cat: Sushi Cat is a pachinko-style game where you drop a hungry cat through pegs and platforms to eat as much sushi as possible.
Click where you want to drop the cat at the top of the level.
cut-the-rope: Cut the Rope is a physics puzzle game: cut ropes to swing a piece of candy into Om Nom's mouth and collect stars on the way.
Swipe across ropes with the mouse to cut them, and tap bubbles and other objects to use them.
bad-ice-cream: Bad Ice Cream is a maze game where you play as an ice cream scoop collecting fruit while avoiding enemies, using ice blocks to block their path.
Move with the arrow keys and press space to create or break ice. Two players can play together.
gun-mayhem: Gun Mayhem is a fast platform shooter where you knock opponents off the map with guns and recoil.
Up to four players can share one keyboard; the controls for each player are shown in the game's menu.
gun-mayhem-redux: Gun Mayhem Redux is an updated version of the platform shooter where the goal is to knock rivals off the stage.
Use the keyboard to move, jump and shoot; up to four players can share one keyboard.
strikeforce-heroes: Strikeforce Heroes is a side-scrolling action shooter with classes, upgrades and team-based missions.
Move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse and click to shoot.
stick-war: Stick War is a strategy game where you lead the Order empire against stick-figure nations: mine gold, train units and conquer.
Use the mouse to train miners and soldiers and give them orders on the battlefield.
age-of-war: Age of War is a strategy game where you defend your base and destroy the enemy's while advancing through five ages, from caves to the future.
Click to train units and build turrets, and earn experience to evolve to the next age.
territorial-io: Territorial.io is a real-time strategy game about expanding your territory on a map against other nations.
Use the slider to choose how many troops to send, then click where to expand or attack.
state-io: State.io is a strategy game where you send troops between bases to capture territory and conquer the map.
Drag from your bases to the base you want to attack.
hole-io: Hole.io is an arcade game where you control a hole in the ground that swallows everything in a city. The more you swallow, the bigger you get.
Move the hole with the mouse and swallow smaller objects before the timer runs out.
infinite-craft: Infinite Craft is a crafting sandbox: start with water, fire, wind and earth, and combine them into new things, from plants to pop culture.
Drag one element onto another to combine them. New results are added to your list to use again.
word-le: Wordle is the five-letter word puzzle: guess the hidden word in six tries, with colored hints after each guess.
Type a five-letter word and press enter. Green means the right letter in the right spot, yellow means the letter is in the word but elsewhere.
getaway-shootout: Getaway Shootout is a two-player racing and shooting game: hop, grab weapons and fight your way to the getaway vehicle before your rival.
Two players can share one keyboard, each using two keys; the controls are shown at the start of the game.
rooftop-snipers: Rooftop Snipers is a two-player shooting game: knock your opponent off the roof with a well-timed shot.
Player one uses W to jump and E to shoot; player two uses the up arrow and the right arrow or set keys.
basketball-stars: Basketball Stars is a 1-on-1 basketball game with dunks, blocks and special shots, against the computer or a friend.
Move with the arrow keys or WASD and shoot and block with the action keys.
basketball-legends: Basketball Legends is a two-player arcade basketball game with famous-looking players, power-ups and special shots.
Move with the arrow keys or WASD and use the action keys to shoot and use your power.
football-legends: Football Legends is a two-player arcade soccer game with big-head players and special shots.
Move with the arrow keys or WASD and kick with the action keys.
factory-balls: Factory Balls is a puzzle game where you recreate a pictured ball by dipping it in paint and covering parts of it with tools in the right order.
Drag the ball to paint pots and tools with the mouse. Think about which parts to cover before you paint.
blox-or-z: Bloxorz is a 3D block-rolling puzzle: roll a tall block across floating tiles and drop it upright into the square hole.
Use the arrow keys to roll the block. Watch out for fragile tiles and switches.
sugar-sugar: Sugar Sugar is a drawing puzzle game: draw lines to guide falling sugar into the cups.
Draw with the mouse to make ramps and channels for the sugar.
tiny-fishing: Tiny Fishing is an idle fishing game: cast your line, catch as many fish as you can on the way back up, and upgrade your gear.
Click to cast and move the mouse to steer the hook. Spend your earnings on longer lines and better hooks.
8-ball-pool: 8 Ball Pool is a pool game: sink your group of balls, solids or stripes, then the 8 ball to win.
Aim with the mouse, set the power and click to shoot.
chess: Chess is the classic strategy board game. Play the full game against the computer in your browser.
Click a piece and then the square you want to move it to.
solitaire: Solitaire is the classic card game: build the four foundation piles from ace to king by moving cards between the columns.
Drag cards with the mouse, or click the deck to draw new cards.
uno: Uno is the classic card game: match the top card by color or number and be the first to get rid of all your cards.
Click a card in your hand to play it, or draw from the deck if you can't.
checkers: Checkers is the classic board game: jump your opponent's pieces diagonally and reach the far side to crown a king.
Click a piece and then the square you want to move to.
blackjack: Blackjack is the classic card game: get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.
Click hit to take a card or stand to keep your hand.
minecraft1-8-8: Minecraft 1.8.8 here is a browser version of the block-building sandbox: mine, craft and build in an open world.
Move with WASD, look with the mouse, left-click to mine and right-click to place blocks.
eaglercraft-x-1-8-8-u29: EaglercraftX 1.8.8 is a fan-made port of Minecraft 1.8.8 that runs in the browser, with single-player worlds and multiplayer servers.
Move with WASD, look with the mouse, left-click to break and right-click to place blocks.
trollfacequest1: Trollface Quest is a puzzle game full of trick solutions and internet memes. Each level looks simple, but the answer is usually the least obvious one.
Click and drag things on the screen to find the solution.
this-is-the-only-level: This Is the Only Level is a puzzle platformer where you play the same level over and over, but the rules change every time.
Move with the arrow keys and read each stage's hint to figure out the twist.
achievement-unlocked: Achievement Unlocked is a platformer about earning achievements: there are 100 to unlock in one small level, from obvious to absurd.
Move with the arrow keys and experiment with everything to unlock achievements.
bubble-tanks: Bubble Tanks is a shooter where you pilot a bubble ship, pop enemy bubbles and grow your tank with new weapons.
Move with WASD, aim with the mouse and click to shoot.
bubble-shooter: Bubble Shooter is the classic match-three puzzle: shoot colored bubbles to make groups of three or more and clear the board.
Aim with the mouse and click to shoot. Bounce shots off the walls to reach tricky spots.
zuma: Zuma is a marble-shooter puzzle: shoot colored balls from a stone frog to match three or more before the chain reaches the skull.
Aim with the mouse, click to shoot and right-click to swap balls.
helix-jump: Helix Jump is an arcade game where you drop a bouncing ball through the gaps of a spinning tower, avoiding the colored segments.
Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate the tower.
stack-ball-io: Stack Ball is an arcade game where you smash a ball down through rotating platforms, avoiding the black segments.
Hold the mouse button or screen to smash downwards; let go to stop.
knife-hit: Knife Hit is a timing game: throw knives into a spinning log without hitting the knives already in it.
Click or tap to throw a knife.
dunk-shot: Dunk Shot is a basketball arcade game: drag to aim and launch the ball from hoop to hoop.
Drag back from the ball and release to shoot.
flappy-dunk: Flappy Dunk combines Flappy Bird with basketball: flap a winged ball through hoops without missing.
Click or press space to flap.
fancy-pants-adventure: The Fancy Pants Adventures is a hand-drawn platformer known for its fluid running, sliding and wall jumps.
Run with the arrow keys and jump with S; press down to slide or duck.
motherload: Motherload is a mining game: drill into the planet Mars, collect minerals, sell them for upgrades and dig deeper.
Drive and drill with the arrow keys and fly up with the up arrow. Keep an eye on fuel and hull.
shift: Shift is a puzzle platformer where you flip the world between black and white to reach the exit.
Move with the arrow keys and press shift to flip the level.
storm-the-house: Storm the House is a defense game: shoot attackers as they run at your house and repair it between waves.
Aim and click to shoot, and press space to reload.
defend-your-castle: Defend Your Castle is a defense game where you fling attackers away from your castle with the mouse.
Click and drag enemies into the air and drop them.
the-last-stand: The Last Stand is a zombie defense game: hold out behind a barricade through the night and scavenge for survivors and weapons during the day.
Aim and shoot with the mouse and reload with R or space.
red-ball: Red Ball is a physics platformer about a red ball rolling through levels full of traps and puzzles.
Move with the arrow keys and jump with up or space.
redball4: Red Ball 4 sends the red ball against an evil square that wants to make the world square.
Roll with the arrow keys and jump with up or space.
cluster-rush: Cluster Rush is a first-person platformer where you jump between moving trucks.
Move with WASD or the arrow keys and jump with space.
space-waves: Space Waves is a rhythm-style arcade game where you guide a wave through tight neon corridors.
Hold the mouse button or space to go up, and release to go down.
level-devil: Level Devil is a troll platformer where the level changes around you: floors vanish and spikes appear when you least expect it.
Move with the arrow keys and jump with up or space.
cat-mario: Cat Mario (Syobon Action) is a notoriously unfair platformer full of trick blocks and surprise traps.
Move with the arrow keys and jump with up or Z.
stickman-duel: Stickman Duel is a two-player stickman fighting game with ragdoll physics and weapons.
Player one uses WASD and player two uses the arrow keys.
ragdoll-archers: Ragdoll Archers is a physics archery game: shoot arrows at a ragdoll opponent and avoid their shots.
Drag to aim and release to shoot.
smash-karts: Smash Karts is a multiplayer kart battle game: drive, collect weapons from boxes and blast your opponents.
Drive with the arrow keys or WASD and use space to fire weapons.
sandbox-els: Sandboxels is a falling-sand simulator with hundreds of elements, from water and fire to plants and explosives.
Pick an element from the menu and draw on the canvas with the mouse.
sp-run-ki: Sprunki is a music-making game inspired by Incredibox: drag sounds onto characters to build a song.
Drag icons from the bottom bar onto the characters to add beats, effects and voices.
friday-night-funk-in: Friday Night Funkin' is a rhythm game: win rap battles by hitting the arrows in time with the music.
Press the arrow keys or WASD when the arrows reach the top.
bald-is-basics: Baldi's Basics is a horror parody of educational games: collect notebooks in a school while the teacher Baldi chases you.
Move with WASD and look with the mouse. Answer the math problems in each notebook.
granny: Granny is a horror game: escape Granny's house in five days while staying quiet so she doesn't hear you.
Move with WASD, look with the mouse and interact with objects to find a way out.
backrooms: The Backrooms is a horror exploration game set in endless yellow rooms with buzzing lights.
Move with WASD and look with the mouse.
bit-life: BitLife is a life simulator: make choices from birth to old age and see what kind of life you end up with.
Click to age up and pick activities, jobs and relationships from the menus.
poly-track: Polytrack is a low-poly racing game with time trials and a track editor.
Drive with the arrow keys or WASD and press R to restart from the last checkpoint.
sui-ka: Suika Game (the watermelon game) is a merging puzzle: drop fruit into a box, and matching fruit merge into a bigger one until you make a watermelon.
Move the fruit with the mouse and click to drop it.
block-blast: Block Blast is a block puzzle game: place blocks on the grid to complete rows and columns and clear them.
Drag blocks onto the board. The game ends when there's no space left for the next piece.
crossy-road: Crossy Road is an endless arcade hopper: cross roads, rivers and train tracks without getting hit.
Press up or tap to hop forward, and use the other arrows to move sideways or back.
geometry-dash-lite: Geometry Dash Lite is a rhythm platformer: jump and fly through levels synced to music.
Click, tap or press space or up to jump.
temple-run2: Temple Run 2 is an endless runner: escape the temple guardians by running, jumping, sliding and turning.
Use the arrow keys to turn, jump and slide.
the-classroom: The Classroom is a stealth game: cheat on your test without getting caught by the teacher.
Click to copy answers when the teacher isn't looking.
snake-is: Snake.is is a version of the classic snake game: eat to grow and don't hit yourself.
bubble-tanks2: Bubble Tanks 2 continues the bubble shooter with new tanks and bigger worlds.
Move with WASD and aim and shoot with the mouse.
